# v3 confirmatory results (generated by scripts/v3/analyse_prereg.py)

Pre-registration: `docs/v3/preregistration_v3.md` (frozen at a08b267). Seeds 5-9. Each row: one condition; estimate = mean over seeds (5 per condition); p = Holm-adjusted one-sided t-test; supported if p < 0.05.

**Corrections to the frozen analysis script (the frozen text defines each test):**
- P5: the script passed the two methods in the wrong order (it tested 'table not better than ECE'). Fixed on 12 Nov 04:40 to test the pre-registered 'table3 - ece3 < 0.05'. No other hypothesis was affected (argument order of every comparison was re-checked against the text).
